summary: Pregnancy termination beyond 24 weeks in case of minor sexual assault victim; Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act, 1971 requirement for medical board assessment; high court rejection reversed; physical/mental harm likelihood confirmed; termination allowed for minor's welfare; interim order facilitating procedure implementation.
legal_provisions_cited: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act 2012 s. 4, s. 8, s. 12
final_judgment: High Court judgment set aside; pregnancy termination approved; medical team constituted; state Responsibilities for transportation and expenses; post-termination care ensured.
